source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 6 May 1939, p. 9 ("Nominations for elections (complete list, continued)"); Belfast News-Letter, 8 May 1939, p. 9 ("Contest in Duncairn Ward: vacant aldermanship")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed (News-Letter, 6 May 1939: sole nominee; 8 May 1939: Duncairn aldermanship the only contest)

note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the 1936 cohort) and the triennial election of seven aldermen (Duncairn, Ormeau, Pottinger, Smithfield, St Anne's, St George's, Woodvale); nominations Friday 5 May, poll Monday 15 May 1939. Sixteen of the 22 seats were filled unopposed at nomination; after four withdrawals on 6 May the Duncairn aldermanship was the only contest in Belfast (Belfast News-Letter, 6, 8 and 16 May 1939). Returned unopposed. Polled Monday 15 May 1939: the Duncairn result was announced at the City Hall at 10.30 the night before the Belfast News-Letter and the Irish News of 16 May 1939 (both p. 7) reported it. The Belfast Corporation register of members (PRONI LA/7/1/CA/1/3) heads this round 16 May 1939, the day after.
